title: Dirac's theorem: k vertices of a k-connected graph lie on a common cycle
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Dirac's 1960 theorem: in a k-connected finite simple graph with k ≥ 2 (more than k vertices, and connected after deleting any set of fewer than k vertices), any set of at most k vertices lies on a common cycle. In particular, in a 2-connected finite graph any two vertices lie on a common cycle. Cycles are Mathlib's `SimpleGraph.Walk.IsCycle`. Mathlib does not have this theorem.
